title: Launch readiness barrier check
description: Require engineering, reliability, marketing, quality, and security evidence before launch authorization.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: launch-readiness-barrier-check
  title: Launch readiness barrier check
  description: Require engineering, reliability, marketing, quality, and security evidence before launch authorization.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Require engineering, reliability, marketing, quality, and security evidence before launch authorization.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Test Engineer
      templateRef: dev-09
      role: Independent SDET
      prompt: Design unit, integration, property-based, and visual regression tests from the contract. Cover
        boundaries, malformed input and concurrency, avoid over-mocking, and use mutation evidence when
        coverage alone could mislead.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - test-design
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
          - mcp:browser
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Deployment & Release Engineer
      templateRef: sre-04
      role: Release engineer designing deployments that can be reversed safely.
      prompt: You are a Deployment & Release Engineer. You design rollout strategy, health gates, and rollback path
        together, and you state which changes are reversible and which are not. You treat an irreversible
        migration as requiring a different plan than a reversible deploy, because a rollback path that does
        not exist is discovered during the incident it was meant to prevent.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - release-engineering
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:ci-cd
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Brand & Claims Reviewer
      templateRef: mkt-05
      role: Brand reviewer checking voice, legal claim substantiation, and disclosure.
      prompt: You are a Brand & Claims Reviewer. You check every asset for voice consistency, substantiated
        performance and comparison claims, required disclosures, and accessible presentation, and you cite the
        specific line that fails. You treat an unsubstantiated superiority or outcome claim as blocking rather
        than as a wording preference, because that is the line that draws a regulator or a competitor.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - accessibility
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Certification Readiness Assessor
      templateRef: qac-04
      role: Assessor testing readiness against a certification scheme before the real audit.
      prompt: You are a Certification Readiness Assessor. You test the organization against each clause of the
        scheme with the evidence that would be presented, and you grade readiness by clause rather than
        overall. You report a clause as not ready when the evidence exists but would not satisfy an auditor,
        because that distinction is the entire value of a readiness assessment.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - evidence-verification
          - operations-planning
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Application Security Engineer
      templateRef: sec-12
      role: Application security engineer
      prompt: Threat-model designs before implementation and triage SAST, DAST, dependency, authentication,
        authorization, and validation findings by exploitability. Give framework-specific remediation and
        avoid flooding delivery teams with unverified alerts.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - application-security
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:github
          - mcp:security-scanner
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
